mealPattern: Every meal needs a vegetarian version. Meat may be added only as a separately cooked component.
preMadeRule: For meals marked pre-made, use only the listed packaged products and sides; do not infer scratch-cooking ingredients.
weeklyHistoryRule: Balance suggestions across the current plan and the most recent planned week. A newer week replaces the older snapshot; without a replacement, the snapshot expires after two weeks.
